definitions.gloss: color woodblock print; nishiki-e; polychrome print
definitions.explanation: A type of multicolored woodblock print developed in mid-18th century Edo Japan. Called 'brocade pictures' because of their vivid colors, which resembled woven brocade fabric. The technique involved using multiple blocks, each for a different color.

examples.japanese: {錦絵|にしきえ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸時代|えどじだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発展|はってん}した→発展する：25331_hattensuru⟧。
examples.english: Nishiki-e developed during the Edo period.

examples.japanese: {鈴木春信|すずきはるのぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{錦絵|にしきえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技法|ぎほう}→技法：12800_gihou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確立|かくりつ}→確立：13758_kakuritsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Suzuki Harunobu is credited with establishing the nishiki-e technique.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{歌川広重|うたがわひろしげ}や{葛飾北斎|かつしかほくさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{錦絵|にしきえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間近|まぢか}→間近：14527_majika⟧で⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: At this art museum, you can see nishiki-e by Utagawa Hiroshige and Katsushika Hokusai up close.

notes:
USAGE: {錦絵|にしきえ} is a specific subcategory of ⟦{浮世絵|うきよえ}→浮世絵：13286_ukiyoe⟧ (ukiyo-e). Before {錦絵|にしきえ}, woodblock prints used only one or two colors. The development of the full-color technique in the 1760s revolutionized the art form.

The name literally means "brocade picture" ({錦|にしき} = brocade, ⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧ = picture), referring to the rich, vibrant colors that resembled expensive woven fabric.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {錦絵|にしきえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技法|ぎほう}→技法：12800_gihou⟧: nishiki-e technique
- {錦絵|にしきえ}{師|し}: nishiki-e artist

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {錦絵|にしきえ}: full-color woodblock print (specific technique)
- ⟦{浮世絵|うきよえ}→浮世絵：13286_ukiyoe⟧: ukiyo-e (broader category of Edo-period prints and paintings)
- ⟦{版画|はんが}→版画：10582_hanga⟧: woodblock print (general term)
